studies.title: First working reconstruction
studies.question: What prevents a recognizable, stable first can reconstruction?
studies.finding: Input geometry, constrained motion, loss changes, and rotation-direction debugging led to the Nice Can milestone.

studies.title: Input preparation and detail
studies.question: How do crop, undistortion, resolution, continuation, and densification affect detail?
studies.finding: Separate continuation from fresh growth experiments; differing preparations limit direct attribution.

studies.title: Multiple camera elevations
studies.question: Can 5°, 30°, and 60° captures produce a coherent shared reconstruction?
studies.finding: Native and prefused geometry, pose, depth, silhouette, and capacity probes survive; smoke checks are distinct from quality evidence.

studies.title: Coverage across products
studies.question: How does a common single-camera setup behave across product captures?
studies.finding: The finalized Session 03 analysis supplies corrected quality, convergence, and cost evidence; failed attempts remain in the ledger.

studies.title: Product isolation and automatic preparation
studies.question: Do SAM product masks and automatic crops remove clutter while retaining useful detail?
studies.finding: Use the aligned common-product target for top-can preparations; down-can and Ramseier are supporting captures.

studies.title: Measured motion and corrections
studies.question: What changes with measured TAE angles and with local/global angle correction?
studies.finding: Fixed measured angles are a useful provisional baseline; angle input and calibrated geometry are not fully isolated.

studies.title: Axis optimization and edge artifacts
studies.question: Are edge spurs related to boundary handling, axis-bound width, or calibration?
studies.finding: R082 projected ±0.5° is the recorded appearance candidate; R084 fixed calibration is the control. Preserve failed R083.

studies.title: Capacity and optimization limits
studies.question: What stops improving, and does extending densification help?
studies.status: Audit complete; matched external follow-up pending
studies.finding: The R081 audit separates scheduled freezing from saturation. R085 extends growth to 20k; the ledger has float endpoint scores.

studies.title: Transfer the R082 setup to more products
studies.question: Does the selected R082 setup transfer to Ramseier, KaegiFret, and Weisswein?
studies.status: Queue defined; consult logs for current outcomes
studies.finding: The current queue uses SAM31AC inputs and projected ±0.5° with fixed TAE angles. New attempts still need stable ledger IDs.
